title: 部门工资最高的员工

cases.setup: CREATE TABLE Employee (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), salary INT, departmentId INT);CREATE TABLE Department (id INT, name VARCHAR(50));INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1,'Joe',70000,1),(2,'Jim',90000,1),(3,'Henry',80000,2),(4,'Sam',60000,2),(5,'Max',90000,1);INSERT INTO Department VALUES (1,'IT'),(2,'Sales');

note: 输出列: Department, Employee, Salary（并列最高都输出）
